mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_login_history (login_history_id, user_type, user_id, login_id, site_id, site_code, result, fail_reason, client_ip, user_agent, session_id, created_ip) VALUES (#{loginHistoryId}, #{userType}, #{userId}, #{loginId}, #{siteId}, #{siteCode}, #{result}, #{failReason}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{sessionId}, #{clientIp})
mapper.select: SELECT login_history_id, user_type, user_id, login_id, site_id, site_code, result, client_ip, user_agent, attempted_at FROM tb_login_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND result = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY attempted_at DESC, login_history_id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_login_history WHERE attempted_at < #{cutoff}
